content.text: No solicitation, no-hire, or inducement restrictions appear anywhere in the agreement — the "Personnel" section addresses only supervision and subcontracting.

input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce" and "recruit" return no restrictive hiring covenant anywhere in the agreement. § 14.8 (Personnel), the likely home for such a covenant, addresses only supervision/direction of each party's own personnel, IBM's right to assign personnel, and IBM's right to subcontract. No non-solicitation or no-hire obligation binds Customer, which matches our preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is needed.
